_meta.description: Hand-authored fixture dataset for agent-handoff-demo. These findings are used to exercise FakeResearcherAgent deterministically in tests and in the demo pipeline. They are NOT the output of a live research process or any LLM call - they are ordinary, verifiable facts about common software topics, written by hand and cited to well-known reference documentation so the demo has something real (if simple) to work with.

python-virtual-environments.claim: The venv module, part of the Python standard library since Python 3.3, is used to create lightweight virtual environments.
python-virtual-environments.source: Python documentation: venv - Creation of virtual environments

python-virtual-environments.claim: Each virtual environment created with venv has its own Python binary and an independent set of installed packages.
python-virtual-environments.source: Python documentation: venv - Creation of virtual environments

python-virtual-environments.claim: Activating a virtual environment on Unix-like shells is done by sourcing the activate script located in the environment's bin directory.
python-virtual-environments.source: Python documentation: venv - Creation of virtual environments

python-virtual-environments.claim: Running pip install inside an activated virtual environment installs packages into that environment only, not system-wide.
python-virtual-environments.source: Python Packaging User Guide: Installing packages using pip and virtual environments

git-basics.claim: git init creates a new, empty Git repository in the current directory.
git commit records a snapshot of the currently staged changes to the repository's history.
git branch, run with no arguments, lists the branches that currently exist in the repository.
A detached HEAD state occurs when HEAD points directly to a commit instead of pointing to a branch reference.
